_comment: Roll calls for the Phase A 117th/118th enacted landmarks. Built by scripts/vr-build-phase-a-vote-seed.mjs from clerk.house.gov/evs and senate.gov roll_call_votes XML; roll numbers come from govinfo BILLSTATUS recordedVote blocks. One decisive vote per chamber per measure — procedural rolls are excluded on purpose. memberVotes is already filtered to db/vr-member-map.json; unmapped members are counted in rosterSkipped and never guessed. isParty is computed from the full chamber tally.

declinedRollCalls.why: vote on the rivers-and-harbors text this vehicle carried before the NDAA replaced it
motion to table reconsideration; roll 119 is the passage vote
failed warrant-requirement amendment; a division vote worth its own mapping in a later pass, not an unmapped ingest here
